description: Source code for handling OBD-II protocol communication, including processing requests, sending responses, and managing supported PIDs within the rusEfi engine firmware.

methods.name: obdSendPacket
methods.description: Constructs and sends an OBD-II response packet over CAN.

methods.name: obdSendValue
methods.description: Converts a float value to integer and sends it as an OBD-II response.

methods.name: obdWriteSupportedPids
methods.description: Writes supported PIDs bitfield to the CAN bus.

methods.name: handleGetDataRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming data requests for specific PIDs and responds accordingly.

methods.name: handleDtcRequest
methods.description: Prepares and sends Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTC) over CAN.

methods.name: obdOnCanPacketRx
methods.description: Receives and processes incoming CAN packets related to OBD-II requests.
